evidence.quote: Grafting moves from late March to the second half of February.

observations.why: Establishes a planned procedural shift for specific upcoming orchard timing.

evidence.quote: last year's March grafts took at under half the rate of the February trial row.

observations.why: Grounds the decision in concrete empirical results and trial observations from the previous year.

evidence.quote: The grafting tape changes to the biodegradable kind, so nobody has to walk the rows in May cutting it off.

observations.why: Directs a material change to avoid a specific anticipated future labor task.
